title: EvalRank Decision Query V2
description: Three required fields. Optional fields narrow the candidates; defaults: via from provider_ids (openai when provider_ids is ["openai"], else openrouter), api chat_completions, reasoning_effort medium, usage_profile the default agent task mix (8,000 cached + 1,000 fresh input + 500 output tokens).

objective.description: lowest_cost_within_top_set: the cheapest configuration of the top band. capability_top_set: the most capable configuration. fallback_chain: every configuration that survives every filter (capability_top_set's filters, max_refusal_score included), in capability_top_set's capability order with no band cutoff, keeping the first configuration per model and then the first per vendor (model_family); selections[0] is the pick and each later selection is the next fallback, most capable first.

band.description: The capability band lowest_cost_within_top_set and capability_top_set choose from: best (default) keeps configurations within 0.97 of the best capability ratio, value within 0.90 (a wider band, so lowest_cost_within_top_set can take a cheaper model that scores up to 10% lower). fallback_chain has no band and ignores it.

via.description: Call surface: openrouter or openai for token cells; fal for media cells (talking-avatar, video-generation), where it is also the default. Any other host answers 422 via_not_supported until its efforts are probed.

reasoning_effort.description: Comparison level; capability_top_set and fallback_chain ignore it unless pinned.

max_refusal_score.description: Highest acceptable refusal score (0..1). Refusal score: 1 - UGI W/10 / 10, from the UGI Leaderboard's private set of unrestricted creative-writing requests. 0 = the model is never pushed into refusing or deviating, 1 = it always is. A ranking signal for how readily a model refuses unrestricted creative writing, not the share of ordinary requests it refuses. When set, only models with a known refusal score at or below it are eligible; a model with no refusal score is excluded (refusal_score_unknown), one above it too (refusal_score_above_max). Omit for no refusal filter.
